evidence.exact_span: We do not have a committed source of financing for the development of our graphite or vanadium projects. While we have spent approximately $55.3 million through December 31, 2022, the remaining capital expenditures to construct Phase I of the Kellyton Graphite Plant are currently estimated at approximately $215.7 million, which amount has increased as a result of the optimization of Phase I of the Kellyton Graphite Plant, and delays in constructing the commercial scale processing facility and other cost overruns may increase that estimate.
